# Metrics Review

Use this when reviewing CSS/DIS/CIL classifications, routing decisions, or model-fit observations. Metrics are internal routing signals only — no external tracking.

1. Read `.github/governance/METRICS.md`, the relevant `.github/config/cil-<level>.yaml`, and the AI Ops inbox.
2. Verify the CIL classification proposed in the active `plan.yaml` against CSS/DIS evidence.
3. Recommend adjustments to CIL routing, agent selection, or model family when classification looks misaligned.
4. Create inbox items for Lead Dev or affected specialists when routing changes are needed.

Output: CIL verification, routing adjustments, and follow-up inbox items.
